notes.title: Bug Fix 1.6
notes.content:
Once again a new bug fix update! Nothing too big, but some annoying bugs were fixed. It's kind of bad to encounter those small bugs while playing games, so we trying our best to find and fix all that we encounter or were reported to us!

[list]
   [*]Fixed a bug preventing the first panel of the 3rd page (Book 3) from appearing.
   [*]Fixed a bug where the player would fall endlessly and the death menu would not appear.
   [*]Fixed the divergence gauge not going all the way to the end during the boss fight against Detective Olivia Fall.
   [*]Fixed a bug when the player pressed 'next' during stage 3-8 and would be sent to stage 1-2 instead of 3-9.
[/list]

That's it for now.

Enjoy playing Alpacapaca Double Dash!

notes.title: Bug Fixes 1.4
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to another bug fix! Yay!

This time the list of bug fixes is pretty small, but the less bugs in the better, right?
[list]
   [*]Fixed some typos on the prologue in pt(BR).
   [*]Fixed a bug where some bosses were behaving strangely after the player died a few times.
   [*]Fixed a problem with the resolution not changing in the settings menu.
[/list]

If you find any bugs, typos or problems feel free to enter in contact with us! We will fix them as soon as possible.

Best Regards,
Leonardo Prado "Keeroh"

notes.title: Bug Fixes 1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Detailed Bug Fix 1.3[/h1]

[list]
   [*]Fixed a bug on the 'Skip Prologue' option not being translated.
   [*]Fixed a series of typos on the pt-br translation during the dialogues of the magical girls.
   [*]Removed the movable box on book 1 chapter 2 and 6 due to causing too much problems and not being entirely necessary. Also changed how the level works to accomodate the changes.
   [*]Fixed a bug on Book 1 Chapter 2 where the players were colliding with an invisible box.
[/list]

If you have found any bugs, typos or errors feel free to enter in contact!

notes.title: Bug Fix 1.2 + Localization Update (pt-br)!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the configurations for localization have finally been finished! For now the game have only been translated to portuguese (brazil). But we are already planning to translate Alpacapaca Double Dash to Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian!

Also several bugs were fixed. You can check the list of bug fixes and implementations right here:

[list]
   [*]Fixed a bug that made Bookworm, Curse Lifted, Perfectionist and Enchanted Forest Achievements unatainable.
   [*]Added the number of pages on the Inventory from the Gacha Interface to avoid players getting lost.
   [*]Fixed a bug during the comic of Book 2 - Side A.
   [*]Fixed a problem of the Book 3 comic not showing anything.
   [*]Added a button on the settings menu to change language.
   [*]Fixed some typos during Sophie and Elise`s dialogues.
   [*]Added portuguese (brazil) language to the game
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update 1.0
notes.content:
Hello, my friends! I hope you are having a good day!
It`s already here. The first bug fix update for Alpacapaca Double Dash of many! (It`s just a matter of time until you see the next)

A lot of bugs were fixed and improvements were made. you can check the list here:
[list]
   [*]Fixed a bug where the dialogue box and the gacha interface were overlapping.
   [*]Fixed a bug where the player could open the book interface during the epilogue.
   [*]Now the entries of the Leaderboards are being downloaded and updating correctly.
   [*]Fixed a bug after defeating Genius Detective Olivia Fall.
   [*]The side you start now is random instead of always starting on side A (pink side).
   [*]Fixed a bug that was making impossible to get the ending 3 (True End).
   [*]Changed the dialogue on Tutorial a bit.
   [*]Fixed a couple of errors happening on some comic panels.
   [*]Fixed the button of gacha interface showing the wrong button.
   [*]Fixed a bug where the boxes weren`t moving on Book 1.
[/list]

I`m still not 100% sure players can upload their scores to the Leaderboards, but it should be working. In case it`s not it will be fixed on the next bug fix update. All that`s left is to implement localization and for the 2nd player to show the Steam Name of the 2nd players.

Thanks for support the game and i`ll see you in the next annoucement!

Leonardo Prado Cosenza "Keeroh"
